statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, file a motivated administrative appeal with the greffe du tribunal de commerce within 2 months; if denied, pursue judicial review before the tribunal administratif or civil court

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) — Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 (common company provisions), L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL governance), and R.123-1 to R.123-40 (Register of Commerce and Companies / RCS registration procedure).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) within the judicial jurisdiction of the registered office, filing channeled through the INPI Registre National des Formalities (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) submitted through the national French corporate formalities online platform, culminating in RCS registration and issuance of the Extrait Kbis.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital requirement (freely fixed, minimum EUR 1 under Article L.223-2 C.com.). Cash contributions must be fully paid up at incorporation where capital is below EUR 10,000, and at least 50% paid up where capital equals or exceeds EUR 10,000, with the balance payable within five years. All cash contributions must be deposited into a blocked escrow account (compte bloqué) held with a commercial bank or with a notary/Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, and released only upon RCS registration. A subscribed capital of EUR 5,000 to EUR 10,000 is strongly recommended for credible bankability in the bitumen wholesale and containerized logistics trade.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — SARL. 1. Share Subscription: The sole founding shareholder confirms subscription in cash of the full share capital and acknowledges the blocked-deposit certificate issued by [BANK]; the Gérant is authorized to release the escrowed funds upon provisional RCS registration. 2. Registered Office Adoption: The registered office is established at [ADDRESS], within the jurisdiction of the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de [TOWN]; the Gérant may transfer the office within the same department, subject to a subsequent amendment of the Articles of Association. 3. Officer Appointments: [FULL NAME], born on [DOB], is appointed Gérant pursuant to Articles L.223-18 et seq. of the French Commercial Code, with unlimited-term ordinary administration powers to open bank accounts, execute commercial agreements, and represent the company before all public and private authorities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Legal counsel or founder drafting, followed by signature under private seal (sous seing privé) or execution before a public notary (notaire) within the notarial jurisdiction of the registered office department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Statuts containing the corporate name, legal form (SARL), share capital amount, corporate purpose strictly limited to wholesale supply and containerized logistics of penetration grade bitumen and asphalt products (ISIC 4661 / NAF 4661B), company duration, registered office address, share distribution, Gérant powers, and governance rules. Verify the availability of the corporate name in the INPI SIRENE database. Have each founding shareholder and the appointed Gérant sign every page of the Statuts, or execute the deed before a notaire if real property is contributed to the company.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of each founding shareholder
INPI SIRENE company name availability verification record
Initial draft of the Articles of Association in French
Justification of the intended registered office (lease title or landlord written authorization)
Signed original Statuts (one original per shareholder plus the registration copy)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry identifies missing or unlawful statutory clauses, a supplementary rectification act (acte rectificatif) is executed by the shareholders to cure the omission; substantive legal defects not affecting third-party interests can also be regularized prior to registration without annulling the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of a Blocked Deposit Account and Blocking of Share Capital (Escrow)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A commercial bank (banque) authorized in France, or a notary acting through the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After execution of the Statuts, open a dedicated temporary corporate account, transfer the subscribed cash capital, and request the blocked funds certificate (certificat de dépôt des fonds / attestation de blocage des fonds) confirming that the amounts are irrevocably frozen until the RCS registration. Retain the certificate as an essential attachment to the incorporation file; funds must not be withdrawn until the Extrait Kbis is delivered by the registry.
required_dossiers: Executed copy of the Articles of Association
Identity documents of the authorized signatories and of the Gérant
Completed bank account opening file including AML/beneficial ownership questionnaire
Bank transfer or deposit slip evidencing payment of the full subscribed capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests further AML/KYC clarifications, respond within five working days; upon persistent refusal, transfer the funds to another bank or to a notary-CDC escrow and obtain a replacement certificate; the deposit date is preserved and the incorporation timeline is unaffected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Incorporation Notice in a Legal Announcements Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A legal announcements journal (Journal d'annonces légales — JAL) authorized by the Préfecture of the department where the registered office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the required notice content (corporate name, legal form SARL, share capital, registered office address, corporate purpose, duration, name of the Gérant, and the RCS court where registration will occur) to the chosen gazette. Pay the publication fee and obtain the attestation de parution. The notice may be published before or simultaneously with the submission of the incorporation file and remains valid for a limited statutory period.
required_dossiers: Requisition text of the legal notice conforming to Article R.210-4 C.com.
Proof of payment of the gazette publication fee
Attestation de parution issued by the legal announcements journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the gazette requires corrections to the draft notice, amend the text and republish; only the corrected publication date counts for the validity window of the blocked funds certificate; obtain a fresh attestation before filing to avoid rejection of the incorporation dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgement of the Incorporation Dossier on the National Corporate Formalities Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI — Registre National des Formalities (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), automatically transmitted to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and ancillary administrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online incorporation form (replacement of the historical CFE/M0 filing), attach all supporting documents in PDF format, declare the beneficial owners, confirm any ICPE/environmental classification of the storage activity, and pay the registry fees electronically. The portal generates a tracking reference and transmits the file to the competent Greffe for RCS registration; monitor the application status until validation.
required_dossiers: Signed Articles of Association (PDF, two original counterparts)
Blocked funds certificate (certificat de dépôt des fonds) issued by the bank or notary
Attestation de parution issued by the legal announcements journal
Justification of the registered office (lease agreement, ownership deed, or written authorization)
Declaration of the beneficial owner (Déclaration des Bénéficiaires Effectifs — DSP)
Attestation de non-condamnation (criminal record certificate) for the Gérant
Identity document of the applicant or legal representative, plus power of attorney if filed by a mandataire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The registry issues a formal regularization notice (demande de régularisation) listing the missing items; the applicant has 15 calendar days to upload the missing documents without losing the filing priority date. If unanswered, the file is rejected and fees are forfeited; a corrected file may be immediately re-submitted online and new fees paid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration, Issuance of the Extrait Kbis, and Release of Escrow
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de [TOWN] (Commercial Court Registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon validation of the file, the commercial registry enters the company on the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés and delivers the Extrait Kbis (official company extract) together with the SIREN/SIRET identifiers, the NAF/APE code 4661B (wholesale of fuels), and VAT/INSEE registrations. The Kbis constitutes the conclusive evidence of incorporation; upon receipt, the company may withdraw the escrowed capital and commence formal trading, including customs and import logistics activities.
required_dossiers: The transmitted INPI/Greffe incorporation dossier
Payment confirmation of the registration fees
Any additional documents requested by the Greffe in the regularization notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Extrait Kbis contains entry errors, submit a written rectification request to the Greffe; for substantive statutory errors, apply to the commercial court for a judicial regularization (action en régularisation); any amendment to the Statuts must be filed through the same online portal with the appropriate modified form.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) acting through the Inspection des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE), under the Prefectoral authority of the department where the storage/warehouse facility is operated, pursuant to Articles L.511-1 et seq. of the French Environmental Code.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Récépissé de déclaration or Arrêté préfectoral d'enregistrement/autorisation au titre des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement — covering warehouse storage of drummed/containerized bitumen under rubrique 1510 (entrepôts couverts) and, where liquid asphalt feedstocks are stored, rubrique 4734 (produits pétroliers spécifiques); delivered via the electronic ICPE/AGATE application and the Prefecture.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique et de la Cohésion des Territoires — Direction Générale de la Prévention des Risques (DGPR), via the DREAL regional inspection service
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Déclaration (D) regime for covered warehouse storage between 500 m³ and 10,000 m³ (rubrique 1510) and for petroleum feedstock storage between 10 and 100 tonnes (rubrique 4734); Enregistrement (ENR) regime for storage capacities above the declaration thresholds and up to the authorization criteria; Autorisation (A) with a full Environmental Impact Assessment (Étude d'impact) and public inquiry is triggered if the facility meets Seveso lower-tier dangerous substance thresholds or exceeds the largest authorized capacities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Ministerial Order of 3 October 2010 (general prescriptions for covered warehouses) including fire compartmentalization, retention basin capacity equal to 100% of the largest storage tank volume, and zero liquid hydrocarbon discharge to soil or groundwater; waste management under Articles R.541-1 et seq. C.env. (hazardous waste tracking, waste code 17 03 02 for asphalt/bitumen residues); atmospheric emissions for PM10/PM2.5 during drum handling and for VOCs from heated bitumen below applicable threshold limit values; ADR classification and packing of dangerous goods transported on French roads.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate and technical inspection delivered by the Commission Consultative Départementale de Sécurité et d'Accessibilité (CCDSA) and the SDIS (Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours) covering evacuation plans, fire detection/extinction systems, and accessibility; structural load inspection certificate issued by an approved control body (Bureau de contrôle, e.g., SOCOTEC) attesting the floor/racking capacity for container stacking; occupational clearance under the French Labor Code including the Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels (DUER), conformity of electrical installations, first-aid organization, and registration of the workplace with the Inspection du Travail.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) under the Ministry of Economy and Finance; principal taxpayer portal: impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a French SARL, incorporation is registered with the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) which transmits to the CFE (Centre de Formalités des Entreprises) and INSEE. INSEE then issues a SIREN (9-digit statutory TIN) and SIRET (14-digit establishment number), while DGFiP issues the intra-community VAT number (FR + 11 digits) upon submission of form Cerfa 07142-2 or 07024-4. A foreign entity not established in France and making taxable French supplies must apply to the SIE (Service des Impôts des Entreprises) using form Cerfa 15579*01, and, if established outside the EU, must appoint a deemed VAT representative who is jointly and severally liable for French VAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: French law does not provide a US-style check-the-box election. A SARL is by default subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) but may elect, under article 239bis CGI, to be taxed in the hands of shareholders at the income tax level if it qualifies as a small family SARL and the election is for five years. Other statutory elections include the option for the 'régime fiscal des sociétés de personnes' in limited cases and the EU anti-hybrid declaration under Article 212bis CGI for hybrid mismatch rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general registration threshold applies; every taxable person making taxable supplies in France must register from the first euro. Micro-businesses may rely on the 'franchise en base de TVA' exemption thresholds of 85,000 EUR for goods sales and 37,500 EUR for services, above which registration becomes compulsory. Non-established foreign taxable persons enjoy no turnover threshold and are registrable from the first euro.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is implementing mandatory domestic B2B electronic invoicing and e-reporting under the 2023 Finance Act. E-invoicing is phased in from 1 September 2026 for large entities and 1 September 2027 for SMEs/VSEs through accredited dematerialisation platforms (PDPs) or the public portal Portail Public de Facturation. Taxpayers must transmit structured invoices and B2B transaction data to DGFiP via the PDP/PPF pipelines; no pre-clearance digital stamping is imposed, but VAT returns and recapitulative statements must be filed electronically on impots.gouv.fr.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export sales of goods physically transported from France to a destination outside the EU qualify for 0% VAT under article 262(I) CGI if the exporter retains conclusive evidence of export, including a valid customs export declaration (ELD/EXA), transport contracts, and proof of removal from the EU within the statutory period. Services can be zero-rated where they are directly linked to exported goods or rendered for a customer established outside the EU under articles 259 and 262(II) CGI, provided the foreign status of the recipient and the extraterritorial performance are substantiated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en douane EXA/ELD with MRN) recorded in the exporter's DEB/DPD registers
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill (AWB) evidencing removal of the goods from the EU territory
Purchase order / sales contract indicating Incoterms and transport destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT proof of payment / repatriation to France
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP and the customs administration (DGA) may verify export evidence and reassess the VAT exemption if documentation is missing or false. Reclaims are accompanied by interest under article 1727 CGI (0.2% per month) and penalties under article 1729 CGI: 40% for deliberate misconduct and 80% for abuse of rights or fraud-related behaviour. In addition, customs fraud rules may apply with fines under the Code des douanes, and excessive refunds obtained through false export declarations are clawed back within the three-year standard assessment period (longer in fraud cases), with possible criminal exposure for the corporate officers.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Direction des Statistiques Monétaires et Financières) together with the Direction Générale du Trésor at the Ministry of Economy and Finance for foreign exchange control, balance-of-payments reporting, and foreign direct investment statistics.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a full EU capital and current-account liberalization jurisdiction under the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. The euro and all Eurozone-linked currencies are freely convertible and remittable in both current and capital account. Profit distribution from a French SARL is lawful provided French Commercial Code solvency tests are met, and no exchange-control license is required. Dividend remittance abroad may be subject to French withholding tax at 12.8% or 25% as applicable, unless reduced by an applicable double-tax treaty or the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive; this tax treatment is prudential and does not constitute exchange control. Cross-border payments to non-resident counterparties are monitored for balance-of-payments statistics and AML/CTF but are not subject to prior administrative authorization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory surrender of export proceeds, no fixed repatriation timeline, and no statutory conversion ratio in France. French resident exporters may retain foreign-currency earnings in foreign or domestic accounts. For statistical and monitoring purposes, transactions with non-resident counterparties equal to or exceeding the Banque de France reporting threshold, generally EUR 12,500 or the equivalent, must be declared by the intermediary French banking institution in the balance-of-payments system. The SARL must ensure the invoice, SWIFT reference, and goods-customs declarations are kept to evidence the free disposal of export receipts and to permit smooth bank compliance clearance.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low_Medium. An EU/EEA-licensed EMI or payment institution can offer operational multi-currency IBANs and SEPA/SWIFT payment execution for collections and operational outflows, but it cannot legally originate commercial letter-of-credit instruments, purchase trade receivables, lend, or provide classic bank guarantees. Because the French SARL is a wholesale physical-commodity trader with need for documentary trade rails, a licensed payment institution is viable only as a secondary collection channel for small counterparty settlements and must have safeguarding accounts at a French credit institution. It should not be used for capital escrow or large bitumen trade disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French AML/CTF rules permit remote client due diligence using a qualified electronic identification solution, including FranceIdentité or EU eIDAS-recognised digital identity. In practice, tier-1 banks for a non-listed SARL will require an interview, conducted either physically or by secure video, with at least one legal representative and each beneficial owner holding 25% or more, plus submission of original or apostilled identity documents and certified corporate documents. Physical presence is not a strict statutory mandate when eIDAS-grade verification is available; however, banks retain contractual discretion and may require physical attendance or notarized legalisation for non-EU resident directors and ultimate beneficial owners. The prudent board-level planning is to assume a combined video and notary confirmation mandate for the SARL managing director and each material natural-person shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership opacity, especially a multi-tiered foreign parent structure or nominee shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current full corporate ownership diagram; authenticated company extract from the French Trade and Companies Register; passport copies of all UBOs above 25%; French notarial certificate of UBO filing; proof of identity residence; and a written UBO declaration to the French bank and the French Tax Agency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High counterparty or sanctions concern from bitumen resale to jurisdictions perceived as near-sanction or embargo-risk, including certain Eastern European, Middle Eastern, or African buyers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions-negative screening report using EU consolidated sanctions lists, OFAC SDN lists, and UN Security Council lists; end-customer attestations with ultimate consignee legal identity; HS code ISIC 4661 and end-use statement confirming road/asphalt application; country-of-origin certificates; trade route documentation with bills of lading and customs export declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Surface indicators of inflated or unexplained turnover relative to SARL declared capital, staffing, or audited financials in wholesale asphalt distribution.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited annual financial statements of the SARL or certified management accounts for the last two financial years; signed supply contracts with refineries or quoted refiners; warehouse-receipt docketing; independent transport agreements; sales invoices and customs entry/exit records; and a treasury cash-flow projection demonstrating that transactional volume is normal in a mere wholesale merchant role.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for inbound capital contribution or large initial trade prepayments from a non-EU parent or related-party financier.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorising the capital increase or subordinated shareholder loan; funds-transfer confirmation from the remitting bank with the same legal identity as the shareholder; three months of remitter bank statements or evidence of treasury surplus; group financial statements of the funding parent; signed loan or capital contribution deed; and confirmation that the funded amount matches the SARL registration filing with the Trade and Companies Registry.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rectification of third-party disbursements, invoice mismatch, or LC discrepancies in the bitumen distribution chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Direct contracting-only policy memo; original commercial invoices between the exact bank account holders and counterparties of record; transport documents presenting a clean title chain; bill-of-lading endorsement record; a professional debt-collection protocol; and a redemption or correction procedure for returned documentary presentations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contribution from a non-French shareholder should be executed by SWIFT MT103 in EUR to the SARL's dedicated EUR account at the French relationship bank, using the receiving French bank's BIC and the SARL's FR76 IBAN. The remittance should carry the explicit purpose reference 'Capital increase SARL' together with the SARL's SIREN number and the corporate decision date. The French bank will capture the transaction for Banque de France balance-of-payments statistics under the foreign direct investment category. The SARL must retain the notarised or in writing shareholders' resolution, bank certificate of receipt, and the Trade and Companies Registry capital-contribution attestation. For a shareholder loan instead of equity, use SWIFT MT103 with reference 'Shareholder current account/subordinated loan', supported by an executed loan agreement, and report accrued interest separately under the France's external-payments statistical filing. Funds received must not be used before completion of the legal verification that a capital increase has been duly decided and, if applicable, filed by the SARL manager.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement for bitumen ex-works and free-on-board purchases should be routed through the French bank's trade-liquidity desk using commercial documentary credits under SWIFT MT700 and cash disbursements under SWIFT MT103. In Eurozone clearing, use SEPA Credit Transfer for low-value Euro payments; for high-value or USD-denominated disbursements, use SWIFT MT103 with explicit payment-stipulated costs and purpose text referencing the invoice number, ISIC 4661 scope, and Harmonisised System tariff heading 2713 or 2715 as appropriate. The bank may require an underlying commercial contract, cargo evidence, and insurance certificate before release of disbursements under a Letter of Credit. For counterparties accepting documentary collections, the French bank can use SWIFT MT400 and MT420 rails, but for asphalt logistics trading, the most compliance-efficient rail is a confirmed irrevocable commercial LC with all documents against payment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EUR/USD foreign-exchange forwards on ISDA 2002 Master Agreement terms
Cross-currency swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps against EUR floating or fixed legs
Vanilla over-the-counter currency options, including EUR calls and puts
Non-deliverable forwards for currencies in which the French bank cannot provide physical EUR-deliverable settlement, limited to genuine commercial exposure and cash-settled under ISDA terms

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts deposition (dépôt des comptes annuels) and management report with the Commercial and Companies Registry (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS registrar) at the company's registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after shareholder approval; approval must be done within 6 months after fiscal year-end (calendar-year entity: approval by 30 June, filing by 31 July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily-fine injunction (astreinte) of up to EUR 75 per day during court procedure; after formal notice, administrative or judicial strike-off of the RCS registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return — liasse fiscale (form 2065 plus annexes from the n°2050/2052–2059 series)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP – Service des Impôts des Entreprises, assigned territorial tax office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Second working day after 1 May for calendar-year fiscal year-end; for non-calendar year, second working day after the 6th month following fiscal close (e-file for all companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late submission penalty on tax due; 40% if filed after formal notice; 80% in case of fraudulent evasion; late interest accrues monthly at statutory French rate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner (bénéficiaires effectifs) control — update declaration if any ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS beneficial-owner register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Mandatory within 30 days after any ownership change; annual internal audit and confirmation dossier for the statutory registers maintained in office may be aligned with the annual meeting date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or to update may trigger an administrative fine up to EUR 7,500 and supplemental criminal sanctions for directors on behalf of the SARL

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of Commissaire aux Comptes when at least two of three thresholds are exceeded: total assets > EUR 4,000,000; revenue net of tax > EUR 8,000,000; average of 50 employees. Also mandatory if shareholder(s) representing at least one-third of registered capital request it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP under Plan Comptable Général (PCG, ANC regulation); individual statutory annual statements are prepared in euro and are not permitted to use IFRS for unlisted legal entities in France, except for consolidated financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: UBO register must be updated within 30 days of any change to beneficial ownership; there is no separate mandatory annual UBO filing. In practice the annual ordinary general meeting should require each direct shareholder and management member to confirm any change. For SARL shares transfer to non-EU resident, strict documentary evidence is required for registration with the RCS.
